title: Settings
subtitle: Connect WhatsApp, manage your team, and configure your workspace.

whatsapp.description: Your WhatsApp Business number and its health
whatsapp.scanQR: Scan this QR code with your WhatsApp

disconnectConfirm.title: Disconnect WhatsApp
disconnectConfirm.message: Are you sure you want to disconnect your WhatsApp account?

warmup.label: Enable warm-up protection
warmup.description: Gradually ramp up daily message limits to protect a new number from being banned. Turn this OFF for established numbers that have been active for months.

whatsapp.qrExpiredHint: Nobody scanned the last few codes, so we stopped generating them — repeatedly refreshing an unscanned code gets the connection rate-limited by WhatsApp. Press "New QR code" when you have your phone ready.
whatsapp.linkBody: Enter your number and we'll give you a code to type into WhatsApp.

team.title: Team Members
team.description: Manage team access to this workspace

removeConfirm.title: Remove Member
removeConfirm.message: Are you sure you want to remove {{name}} from the team?

savedReplies.title: Saved Replies
savedReplies.description: Use shortcuts like /thanks in the message box
savedReplies.messagePlaceholder: Thanks for reaching out. We'll get back to you shortly.

deleteConfirm.title: Delete Reply
deleteConfirm.message: Are you sure you want to delete this saved reply?

signOutConfirm.title: Sign Out
signOutConfirm.message: Are you sure you want to sign out?

password.title: Change Password
password.description: Update your password to keep your account secure
password.securityNotice: For security reasons, you will need to log in again after changing your password.

errorMessages.passwordTooShort: New password must be at least 8 characters
errorMessages.passwordSame: New password must be different from current password

language.title: Language & Region
language.description: Choose your preferred language. The interface will update immediately.
language.restartNotice: Language changes apply instantly without reloading.

customFields.title: Contact fields
customFields.subtitle: Define the information your business tracks. Custom fields appear on contact profiles, in the import mapper, in filters, and as personalization tokens in broadcasts.
customFields.emptyBody: Add the fields your business actually uses — city, plan, renewal date, credit limit.

notify.title: Notifications
notify.description: Get alerts on this phone or computer — even when Nexus is closed.

device.label: This device
device.on: On — alerts arrive here even when the app is closed.
device.off: Off — you'll only see alerts while Nexus is open.
device.needsInstall: Add Nexus to your Home Screen to get alerts on this iPhone.
device.serverOff: Phone alerts aren't set up on the server yet.

messages.label: Messages
messages.hint: Customers writing in on chats that are yours or your team's.

assignments.label: Assignments
assignments.hint: A chat or task is assigned to you.

mentions.label: Mentions & replies
mentions.hint: Someone @mentions you or replies in a note thread you're in.

comments.label: Comments
comments.hint: A teammate adds a note to a chat assigned to you.

reviews.label: Lead reviews
reviews.hint: The AI flags a hot lead or a customer who needs a person.

deadlines.label: Deadlines
deadlines.hint: Your tasks are due tomorrow, today, or overdue.

test.sentNoDevice: Test added to your inbox. Turn on this device to get it as a phone alert.
test.failed: Couldn't send the test. Try again.

prompt.title: Never miss a customer
prompt.body: Turn on notifications to hear about new messages, chats assigned to you, mentions and due tasks — even when Nexus is closed.
points: Chats and tasks assigned to you
prompt.iosBody: iPhone only shows notifications for apps on your Home Screen. It takes 10 seconds:
iosSteps: Tap the Share button in Safari
Open Nexus from the new icon and tap Allow
prompt.blockedBody: This browser was told not to show notifications from Nexus. To turn them back on:

android: Tap the lock icon next to the address (or long-press the app icon → App info)
Allow them, then come back here
desktop: Click the lock icon at the left of the address bar
